name: Exp. Share
effect: This item, when held by a Pokémon, allows it to earn half the EXP gained from defeating a Pokémon, regardless of if it was used in battle or not.In Pokémon X & Y, the item is now a Key Item and can be turned on or off. Doing so results in all Pokémon receiving the EXP. They receive 100% of the EXP if in battle, and 50% of the EXP if they were not in battle.
